```yaml
name: Gemini Code Review
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
    branches: [main]
# Prevent concurrent reviews on the same PR
concurrency:
  group: gemini-review-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  review:
    name: Code Review
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Don't run on draft PRs or dependabot
    if: |
      github.event.pull_request.draft == false &&
      github.actor != 'dependabot[bot]'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Gemini Code Review
        uses: google/gemini-code-review@v0.2.0
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          gemini_api_key: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
          model: gemini-2.5-flash
          prompt: |
            Review this pull request. Focus on:
            - Code correctness and potential bugs
            - Rust idioms and best practices
            - Performance implications
            - Test coverage for changes
            - Documentation completeness

            Be constructive and specific. If changes look good, say so briefly.
```
